epilogue_ch1: Use case: stylized-concept. Production mobile candy fantasy RPG illustrated STORY PANEL ATLAS, Chapter 1. ONE atlas with exactly TWO columns and THREE rows, SIX equal landscape cells, each cell 16:9. Entire canvas ratio 32:27. Rows and columns have straight exact halfway / third boundaries; zero gutters, zero borders. First FIVE cells are separate complete edge-to-edge painted environmental story illustrations in row-major order; sixth cell bottom-right must be a plain dark plum empty rectangle. Each panel depicts its DIFFERENT post-boss event described below. Paint glossy candy fantasy storybook scenes with chibi-scale props, intricate but readable big silhouettes, dramatic atmospheric light, coherent dark outlined painted style. Landscape wide framing with meaningful story focal point in center third, not generic battlefield. No UI, no captions, no words, no letters, no numbers, no comic speech, no text ANYWHERE. NO invented characters or protagonist; show events through the environment, broken curse objects, freed spirits, seeds and flowers. No gore. Five cells: CELL 1 (top left): The Empress Falls Silent. Event: The Acid Ant Empress shatters and the crystal orders lose their grip. The freed ants remember their own names — and point Momo toward the drains where the sour acid still flows. Next direction: Follow the poisoned current downstream to find its source. | CELL 2 (top right): The Pipes Run Clear. Event: Clogmaw bursts and the fermented flood drains away. In the last trickle Momo hears a furnace roar far below — something is boiling the stolen acid into raw power. Next direction: Descend to the Chili Engine before it finishes stoking. | CELL 3 (middle left): The Furnace Goes Cold. Event: Mr. Griddle sputters out and his cursed engine stalls. But that heat was feeding a freezer above, where sweet flavor-spirits are being frozen as the next batch of fuel. Next direction: Climb to the Sugar Frost Prison and free the captured flavors. | CELL 4 (middle right): The Ice Lets Go. Event: The Golem melts into slush and the frozen spirits drift free, whispering their thanks. They warn of a crown-shaped oven higher up, where the Bitter Chef prepares his final course. Next direction: Ascend to the Crown Oven and end the Bitter Chef for good. | CELL 5 (bottom left): The Great Hunger Recedes. Event: The Great Hunger collapses and taste floods back into Mochitopia in a rush of color and sound. Yet from the cooling oven a single crown seed rolls free — and roots upward, toward the garden above. Next direction: Chapter 1 is complete. Chase the seed into the Fermented Canopy.. Each cell clearly visually different; original titles are semantic guidance, never render them as text.
